Product illustration vocabulary

Three things carry these: the person in the card, the ground behind it, and UI kept to a hint. Grounds and glass treatments below, then six compositions built the way the references are — on our palette, with our people, in Nunito Sans.

Grounds

Twenty-two, from the tokens. Tonal singles for most cards. Rises when the card should stand in the colour and bleed off the bottom. Blends run into a deep end — Tide is sky into our own teal. Spans run sideways. Blooms for a layered pair. Deep at most once a page.

Glass

Four treatments for a card on a ground. Solid is the default. Frost when a second card sits behind the hero, or the card should belong to the ground. Rim is a white card wearing a translucent border that lets the ground through — the reference's availability card. Tile is the floating satellite: a system logo, a glyph.

Solid
Solid — the default
Frost
Frost — 72% white, 20px blur, 1px light rim
Rim
Rim — 6px translucent border, ground shows through
Tile — 68px satellite, glass, soft shadow

Compositions

Each is one reference's construction, rebuilt with our people, our product and our grounds. The person is the largest thing in the card; the UI says which feature this is and stops there.

The rules that make it one system

RuleWhy
A person is the largest thing in the cardAvatar 84–96px, or a photo tile that takes a third of the card. The UI names the feature; the person is the reason to look.
One hue per illustrationGround, tinted controls, accent bar and button gradient all share it. A second hue is the fastest way off-system.
UI is a hintOne title, one line of meta, skeleton lines for anything longer, at most one button. Never a full screen.
Radii: frame 28 · card 24 · photo 16 · controls 12 · pills 9999One step softer than the site's own so illustrations read as artwork.
Glass has three jobsFrost for a card behind the hero or one that belongs to the ground; rim for a white card on a deep blend; tile for a satellite. Solid otherwise.
Bleed one edge when the card is standing in the colourRises and glass splits crop the card; tonal singles usually don't.
Nunito Sans, ladder sizes, no shadow on the card24/18/16/14/12. 600 only on titles and buttons. Shadows only on satellites.
